resources.string: Receive incoming SMS on-device and forward each message to your n8n or custom webhook as JSON.
Save the HTTP or HTTPS endpoint that should receive each incoming SMS payload.
Enter a valid http:// or https:// webhook URL.
Use the exact n8n webhook URL, for example https://host/webhook/<id>.
RECEIVE_SMS is not granted yet. The app cannot capture incoming SMS until you allow it.
RECEIVE_SMS is granted. Incoming SMS broadcasts can now be captured.
SMS permission was denied, so forwarding is still disabled.
INTERNET is declared in the manifest and granted automatically by Android. It does not have a runtime permission dialog.
The broadcast receiver hands each SMS to WorkManager, which posts JSON with OkHttp in the background and retries automatically after network failures or retryable server errors.
RCS is not exposed to third-party apps through the SMS_RECEIVED broadcast, so this project can forward SMS but not native RCS conversations.
